ReplenishmentItem.title: Replenishment Item
ReplenishmentItem.description: Represents an item requested for replenishment from the store floor.

janCode.description: The barcode (JAN code) of the product.

quantity.description: The quantity to replenish (e.g., '2 cases', '5 items').

status.description: The current status of the replenishment request.

BbsMessage.title: BBS Message
BbsMessage.description: Represents a post on the workplace bulletin board for co-workers.

likedBy.description: List of user names who reacted to the post to avoid dupes.

BbsReply.title: BBS Message Reply
BbsReply.description: Represents a comment / reply under a specific BBS post.

author.description: Name of the colleague who replied to the post.

ProductMasterItem.title: Product Master Item
ProductMasterItem.description: Represents product details mapped by JAN code in the product master database.

janCode.description: The barcode (JAN code) of the product.

maker.description: The manufacturer or brand of the product.

size.description: The size, capacity, weight, or dimensions of the product.

remarks.description: Any additional notes, remarks, or specification details.

recordNumber.description: The unique 10-character alphanumeric RECORD_# for tracking.

createdAt.description: When the product was added to master.

/product_master/{itemId}.description: Master list of products mapped by JAN code.

/bbs_messages/{messageId}.description: Collection of all bulletin board system posts.

/bbs_messages/{messageId}/replies/{reply.description: Subcollection of replies on a particular post.
